10void ASideScrollingCameraManager::UpdateViewTarget(FTViewTarget& OutVT, float DeltaTime)
11{
12 // ensure the view target is a pawn
13 APawn* TargetPawn = Cast<APawn>(OutVT.Target);
14
15 // is our target valid?
16 if (IsValid(TargetPawn))
17 {
18 // set the view target FOV and rotation
19 OutVT.POV.Rotation = FRotator(0.0f, -90.0f, 0.0f);
20 OutVT.POV.FOV = 65.0f;
21
22 // cache the current location
23 FVector CurrentActorLocation = OutVT.Target->GetActorLocation();
24
25 // copy the current camera location
26 FVector CurrentCameraLocation = GetCameraLocation();
27
28 // calculate the "zoom distance" - in reality the distance we want to keep to the target
29 float CurrentY = CurrentZoom + CurrentActorLocation.Y;
30
31 // do first-time setup
32 if (bSetup)
33 {
34 // lower the setup flag
35 bSetup = false;
36
37 // initialize the camera viewpoint and return
38 OutVT.POV.Location.X = CurrentActorLocation.X;
39 OutVT.POV.Location.Y = CurrentY;
40 OutVT.POV.Location.Z = CurrentActorLocation.Z + CameraZOffset;
41
42 // save the current camera height
43 CurrentZ = OutVT.POV.Location.Z;
44
45 // skip the rest of the calculations
46 return;
47 }
48
49 // check if the camera needs to update its height
50 bool bZUpdate = false;
51
52 // is the character moving vertically?
53 if (FMath::IsNearlyZero(TargetPawn->GetVelocity().Z))
54 {
55 // determine if we need to do a height update
56 bZUpdate = FMath::IsNearlyEqual(CurrentZ, CurrentCameraLocation.Z, 25.0f);
57
58 } else {
59
60 // run a trace below the character to determine if we need to do a height update
61 FHitResult OutHit;
62
63 const FVector End = CurrentActorLocation + FVector(0.0f, 0.0f, -1000.0f);
64
65 FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams;
66 QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(TargetPawn);
67
68 // only update height if we're not about to hit ground
69 bZUpdate = !GetWorld()->LineTraceSingleByChannel(OutHit, CurrentActorLocation, End, ECC_Visibility, QueryParams);
70
71 }
72
73 // do we need to do a height update?
74 if (bZUpdate)
75 {
76
77 // set the height goal from the actor location
78 CurrentZ = CurrentActorLocation.Z;
79
80 } else {
81
82 // are we close enough to the target height?
83 if (FMath::IsNearlyEqual(CurrentZ, CurrentActorLocation.Z, 100.0f))
84 {
85 // set the height goal from the actor location
86 CurrentZ = CurrentActorLocation.Z;
87
88 } else {
89
90 // blend the height towards the actor location
91 CurrentZ = FMath::FInterpTo(CurrentZ, CurrentActorLocation.Z, DeltaTime, 2.0f);
92
93 }
94
95 }
96
97 // clamp the X axis to the min and max camera bounds
98 float CurrentX = FMath::Clamp(CurrentActorLocation.X, CameraXMinBounds, CameraXMaxBounds);
99
100 // blend towards the new camera location and update the output
101 FVector TargetCameraLocation(CurrentX, CurrentY, CurrentZ);
102
103 OutVT.POV.Location = FMath::VInterpTo(CurrentCameraLocation, TargetCameraLocation, DeltaTime, 2.0f);
104 }
105}
